_comment: Which wiki Cargo tables to fetch, and what to expect back.
expectedRows is asserted after fetching. A mismatch fails the fetch rather than
writing a short file, because silently truncated pagination is the failure mode
that corrupts everything downstream without ever looking wrong.
excludedFields records what we deliberately do NOT request, and why. Not asking
for prose is a stronger guarantee than asking and stripping afterwards.
Row counts confirmed live against Special:CargoTables on 2026-08-17,
after the 2026-08-17 refresh run failed on Items 1196 vs 1197 — the wiki
genuinely changed (Items -1, Characters +2, GiftPrefs +1), not truncation.
Table names live here rather than in code because FurnitureTEMP is explicitly
named TEMP and will be renamed.
_throttle_comment: 1s between requests. GiftPrefs needs eleven of them and wiki.gg returns 429 at 400ms. This is a volunteer-run community wiki; being slow is the correct behaviour.

_notFetched.reason: in-character museum placard text — prose, and exactly what docs/DATA-POLICY.md forbids. Not fetched at all rather than fetched and stripped.
explicitly named TEMP and expected to be renamed; furniture is already present in Items and adds nothing the museum or availability model needs. Revisit once the table has a stable name.
wiki display ordering, not game data.
